notes: `if isHardFail { writeLastStartupResult(...) }` (line 220-222) is conditional -- a server that reached ready state and then stopped unexpectedly (e.g. crashed mid-session, not during boot) never touches `last_startup_result.json` at all, even though the generic alert still fires unconditionally in the same `else` block (line 224-227). The "Last Startup" health card therefore keeps showing the prior clean boot's green state through a later mid-session crash.
